elaine-f: FYI the pricing experiment produced 3 prepaid invoices that were posted to revenue instead of deferred. Need quick fix before close.
jon_p: list the invoices and amounts?
elaine-f: INV-2026-0501 $60,000, INV-2026-0507 $48,000, INV-2026-0512 $42,000. Service start 2026-05-01 for all.
samir: GL shows they hit Rev-Sub (4000). We should reclass net of any invoice discounts.
billing-bot: note: INV-2026-0507 had a promo_discount $3,000 applied on invoice.
jon_p: proposed JE: Dr Revenue 147,000 / Cr Deferred Revenue 147,000 (net of discounts). Amortize monthly over 12 months from 2026-05-01 -> 12,250/mo.
elaine-f: agree. Samir, can you post JE and attach deferral schedule?
samir: will post JE-2026-05-801 this afternoon and upload schedule.
audit-bot: reminder: add a one-paragraph memo for auditors describing experiment and corrective entry.
elaine-f: I'll draft and attach to the close binder.
jon_p: thanks team. Closing checklist updated. :white_check_mark:
